Encoders count motor rotations in ticks. They let you measure distance precisely instead of guessing with timing.

getCurrentPosition() returns the accumulated tick count.

Declare private DcMotor motor.

In init(), get "front_left_motor" from hardwareMap.
In loop(), call motor.getCurrentPosition() and display it with telemetry.addData("Encoder", ticks).

Set power to 0.5 while getCurrentPosition() < 1000, then stop.

This is position-based control. More accurate than timing.
